summary: A long research turn's token budget doubles to 512k, so a chain of web searches and page fetches finishes instead of being cut off mid-answer.
details: The agent loop's cumulative token ceiling was 256,000, sized in August on the reference-image chain.

A measured Discord research turn (four web searches, three page fetches) re-paid a context that grew with every fetched page — 32,791 rising to 45,599 input tokens per call, 276,126 cumulative — and stopped on limit_total_tokens at call seven with the reply truncated.

The ceiling is now 512,000, restoring the same ~2x headroom over a measured worst case that every prior raise was sized on. config.toml and config.example.toml both move; the 20-round-trip cap is unchanged.
limitations: This raises the ceiling; it does not make her search less. A turn that keeps fetching can still reach the new cap.
